ruleDefinitions.name: Office Autorun Keys Modification
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Wow6432Node\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office.*")) AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Word\\\\Addins.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\PowerPoint\\\\Addins.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Outlook\\\\Addins.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Onenote\\\\Addins.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Excel\\\\Addins.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Access\\\\Addins.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*test\\\\Special\\\\Perf.*")) AND  NOT (Details = "\(Empty\)" OR ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\ Office\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\msiexec\\\.exe") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe")) AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Excel\\\\Addins\\\\AdHocReportingExcelClientLib\\\.AdHocReportingExcelClientAddIn\\\.1\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Excel\\\\Addins\\\\ExcelPlugInShell\\\.PowerMapConnect\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Excel\\\\Addins\\\\NativeShim\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Excel\\\\Addins\\\\NativeShim\\\.InquireConnector\\\.1\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Excel\\\\Addins\\\\PowerPivotExcelClientAddIn\\\.NativeEntry\\\.1\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Outlook\\\\AddIns\\\\AccessAddin\\\.DC\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Outlook\\\\AddIns\\\\ColleagueImport\\\.ColleagueImportAddin\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Outlook\\\\AddIns\\\\EvernoteCC\\\.EvernoteContactConnector\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Outlook\\\\AddIns\\\\EvernoteOLRD\\\.Connect\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Outlook\\\\Addins\\\\Microsoft\\\.VbaAddinForOutlook\\\.1\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Outlook\\\\Addins\\\\OcOffice\\\.OcForms\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Outlook\\\\Addins\\\\OneNote\\\.OutlookAddin.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Outlook\\\\Addins\\\\OscAddin\\\.Connect\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Outlook\\\\Addins\\\\OutlookChangeNotifier\\\.Connect\\\\.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Outlook\\\\Addins\\\\UCAddin\\\.LyncAddin\\\.1.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Outlook\\\\Addins\\\\UCAddin\\\.UCAddin\\\.1.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Outlook\\\\Addins\\\\UmOutlookAddin\\\.FormRegionAddin\\\\.*"))) OR ((process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Common\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Shared\\\\ClickToRun\\\\") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Common\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Shared\\\\ClickToRun\\\\Updates\\\\")) AND process_path = RGX("\\\\OfficeClickToRun\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = "C\:\\Program\ Files\\AVG\\Antivirus\\RegSvr\.exe" AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Office\\\\Outlook\\\\Addins\\\\Antivirus\\\.AsOutExt\\\\.*")))
